_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Production-over-research Thursday — four-pronged platform avalanche: Cursor 3 Glass (biggest IDE overhaul since 2023, full-screen Agents Window for parallel agents, Design Mode visual targeting, kick-offs from mobile/Slack/GitHub/Linear, Composer 2 in same release — direct Claude Code + Codex CLI head-to-head on parallel-agent UX), Gemma 4 (open-weight 2B/4B/26B-MoE/31B Apache 2.0, 256K context multimodal, AIME 2026 20.8→89.2 / LiveCodeBench 29.1→80.0 / GPQA 42.4→84.3, 31B-Dense Arena 3rd / 26B-MoE 6th, on-device E2B/E4B push agentic capability to phones via Android AICore — strongest open-weight Gemini-class drop yet), Amazon OpenSearch agentic AI for log analytics (chatbot + Investigation Agent plan-execute-reflect over PPL queries with ranked hypotheses + persistent agent memory, Claude Sonnet 4.6 via Bedrock across 9 regions at no additional cost — first big-three hyperscaler default-on agentic UI for observability into Splunk/Datadog/New Relic lane), ServiceNow Action Fabric + AI Control Tower expansion (Action Fabric is the gating layer every external agent must traverse, AI Control Tower covers 30 net-new AWS/GCP/Azure/SAP/Oracle/Workday integrations — consolidated audit-and-attestation surface ahead of EU AI Act 2 Aug GP-AI obligations). Plus Mistral Le Chat Enterprise (SharePoint/Drive/Gmail connectors + on-prem GDPR + agent builder — European-sovereign pitch), Pichai signals Cloud Next prep (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform + 8th-gen TPUs preview for 21 April keynote), MCP Dev Summit NYC Day 1 (1,200 attendees / 95+ sessions). Research wave: Terminal Agents Suffice for Enterprise Automation (plain terminal coding agent ties/beats MCP/tool-augmented stacks — sharpest research counter-thesis to MCP-first direction), MyPhoneBench (privacy contract eval reshuffles model rankings vs accuracy alone), ClawKeeper (skill/plugin/watcher defense framework for open agent runtimes), Reasoning Shift (context length systematically compresses reasoning traces — models silently truncate verification on harder items), Brevity Constraints Reverse Performance Hierarchies (length budget flips bigger-is-better on multiple benchmarks), HippoCamp personal-computer file-management benchmark, MiroEval deep-research process-and-outcome eval. Blogs: Willison hands-on Gemma 4 + 3,558-word Lenny's Podcast annotated transcript on agentic-coding inflection. Stage moves: agent-evaluation-observability surges from process-only papers to enterprise observability product day; new topic 'agentic-observability-stack' spawns from OpenSearch + Cursor 3 + ServiceNow Action Fabric convergence; mcp-adoption fast EMA bounces back to high on Day 1 of MCP Dev Summit NYC + ServiceNow Action Fabric MCP-everywhere counter to SAP walled-garden.
